top_headline: روبيو ووزير الخارجية السعودي يدينان هجمات الحوثيين ويشددان على الملاحة في هرمز - houseofsaud.com
llm_summary:
- US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan condemn Houthi attacks on Saudi civilians, infrastructure, and energy facilities.
- The officials emphasize the importance of ensuring freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandeb.
- Aramco's production over nine months has declined by 13.7%, with pipeline attacks keeping Yanbu below 3 million barrels per day.
- Both main crude oil export routes in Saudi Arabia are operating well below their maximum capacity in November 2026.
- The Houthis threaten Jeddah and Saudi ports on the Red Sea following strikes on Al Hudaydah.
- Brent crude registers its third weekly loss, dropping below $89 per barrel for the first time since August.
- This decline puts the global benchmark well below the level needed for Saudi Arabia to cover its wartime budget.
- Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman calls Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Meshal Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah to inquire about his health after medical checks in the US.
- OPEC+ will meet on November 29 to determine production quotas for 2027 without a plan for the post-December period.
- The meeting will coincide with the 69th session of the Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee.
- The Saudi-led coalition intercepts two Houthi ballistic missiles over Jazan, with debris falling in Al-Shaqeeq.
- The coalition strikes 60 targets in Yemen as Houthi forces advance to within 100 km of Aden.
- Iranian Revolutionary Guard claims a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels of oil sank in the Gulf after hitting a mine
